notes.title: No Recollection has Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I’m here to announce that the game has been released! 

If you’ve played the demo, you can skip straight to day 2 by clicking the “Extra” button on the menu and choosing “Chapters.” This will unfortunately spoil how many chapters the game has if you care about that, as they will all be available. However, achievements have been added to day 1 if you’re an achievement hunter (not that this game will contribute towards your global achievement counter) so that may be an incentive to play again or skip through to find them all. The demo has also been delisted from Steam, given that its existence is pointless now.

The swimsuit DLC I mentioned in the previous announcement has also been released. It is $1.99, and if you'd like, you can show support for the game by purchasing it. Although, I would recommend not using it if you decide to buy it, since it’ll ruin the game. But if you're not really liking the game, maybe the swimsuits will make it more enjoyable.

It feels crazy to me that I was able to finish this project. It’s almost been 3 years since I began writing the story, which granted, it shouldn’t have taken this long, but I was really bad at motivating myself to work on it. And now, almost a year after completing the story and starting the actual game’s development, it’s fully finalized. I know it has some issues, but I’m happy with how it turned out. And I’m happy with myself for accomplishing this goal. Hopefully this will be the start of my creative journey!

It may not be the craziest or most unique story ever written – nor is the game very high budget looking aesthetically - but I still think it’s a worthwhile read. 
I may make another VN someday in the future – I would like to, and I have a few ideas – but for now, I think I should take a break. For now, I don't think I want to put myself through the process of writing another novel. I have some other things I want to try creating.


If you read all this, thank you and I hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I am happy to announce that the game has been fully completed! And so, it will be released in exactly a month from now on June 7th. Please look forward to it!


I had a deadline set for myself - the announced date - and I was able to finish in time. I’m both shocked and proud of myself that I was able to finish with a whole month to spare. Another month isn’t needed, as I’ve already tested everything several times; however, that’s the date I wanted to release on for no particular reason. So now, I have extra time, so I decided to make some fun extra stuff!

For example: I will be adding some fun swimsuit DLC, because every anime game has to have that! I know day 1 DLC gives games a bad look, but it isn’t really substantial – if anything, I don’t want people to use it since it ruins the game. It just seemed like a fun thing to make. The price will be $1.99, so please don’t judge me too harshly. It’s just a little way to show support, given that the entire game will be free. 


Thank you for reading!
